result.question: Quais capitulos CID concentram mais internacoes de alto custo acima do percentil 99 do valor total?
result.gold_sql: WITH limite AS (SELECT QUANTILE_CONT("VAL_TOT", 0.99) AS p99_valor FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL), alto_custo AS (SELECT i."DIAG_PRINC", i."VAL_TOT" FROM internacoes i, limite l WHERE i."VAL_TOT" > l.p99_valor) SELECT c."DS_CAPITULO" AS capitulo_cid, COUNT(*) AS internacoes_alto_custo, ROUND(SUM(a."VAL_TOT"), 2) AS custo_total_alto_custo FROM alto_custo a JOIN cid c ON a."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" GROUP BY c."DS_CAPITULO" ORDER BY internacoes_alto_custo DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: WITH internacoes_custos AS ( SELECT SUBSTR(i."DIAG_PRINC", 1, 1) AS cid_capitulo, SUM(i."VAL_TOT") AS valor_total_internacoes FROM internacoes i GROUP BY cid_capitulo ), percentil_99 AS ( SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY valor_total_internacoes) AS valor_99 FROM internacoes_custos ) SELECT ic.cid_capitulo, ic.valor_total_internacoes FROM internacoes_custos ic JOIN percentil_99 p ON ic.valor_total_internacoes > p.valor_99 ORDER BY ic.valor_total_internacoes DESC;
